segments.name: Fuel cell technology
segments.description: Develops and commercializes fuel cell technology and products, including carbonate and solid oxide platforms, for distributed power and hydrogen customers.
segments.evidence: the development and commercialization by FuelCell Energy, Inc. and its subsidiaries ("FuelCell Energy," "Company," "we," "us" and "our") of fuel cell technology and products and the market for such products

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for power platform and component sales, service agreements, power purchase agreements, and Advanced Technologies contracts, generally billed on contractual milestones or costs incurred.
revenueModel.evidence: We bill customers for power platform and power platform component sales based on certain contractual milestones being reached.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company implemented a global restructuring that re-focused the business on its core carbonate technologies.
changes.evidence: Our development timeline for bringing our solid oxide electrolysis technology to market has shifted as a result of delays in adoption of clean energy technologies generally and implementation of our recent global restructuring actions, which have re-focused our business on our core carbonate technologies.
